## Context / Problem
Six private mechanism-delta modules contain repeated, historical, or inaccurate prose identified by the comment audit and revalidated on `origin/main` at `0033662b5534531d84e39d4a14bf75c8e768e85e`. Shortening their runtime docstrings must not alter executable structure or the detector contract.

## Approach
Edit only comments/docstrings and blank lines in the declared files. Preserve non-docstring AST, test assertions, and exact directives. Runtime `__doc__` changes are intentional; no user-facing argparse consumer was found for these private modules.

## Scope
- `scripts/_mechanism_delta/__init__.py` — State the seven-kind `DETECTORS` dispatch, input-surface grouping, private-subpackage boundary, import isolation, and the entrypoint's `scripts/` path dependency; remove extraction history, LOC rationale, and the false shared-cache implication.
- `scripts/_mechanism_delta/compare.py` — Preserve the four exact buckets; qualify `increased` as unreachable only for validated presence-only values; retain stale-only pass, pure/injectable evaluation, exact-key nonblank marker admission, and `drain_stale` never folding in new keys. Say every harvested marker, not every marker anywhere.
- `scripts/_mechanism_delta/detect_ci.py` — Preserve both `ci_gate` shapes, `test_helper` naming, PyYAML ownership, named-step versus first nonblank run-line fallback truncated to 60 characters, site-qualified names, marker placement, and unreadable/malformed-YAML skip behavior.
- `scripts/_mechanism_delta/detect_code.py` — Preserve lock-class regex and `.lock` string-literal definitions, source/test roots, terminal-name autouse-fixture recognition with literal `autouse=True`, site qualification, and fail-open unreadable/unparseable-Python handling. Remove the false shared-parse-cache claim.
- `scripts/_mechanism_delta/detect_config.py` — Preserve canonical path-loading of `gen_env_registry.scan`, derived aliases plus `MCP_ENV_VARS`, `REBAR_*` filtering, literal-site attribution with file-head fallback, empty-surface behavior on missing registry/import, `_SECTIONS` extraction, section-qualified names, and the exclusive boolean-to-`feature_flag`/nonboolean-to-`config_key` partition. Correct the false “feature_flag remainder” wording and remove volatile counts.
- `scripts/_mechanism_delta/markers.py` — Preserve exact marker syntax, exact-key scope, nonblank-reason rule, whitespace-surrounded separator semantics, names containing spaces or `::`, `HEAD_LINES=20`, `Site`/`MarkerMap` shapes, and all four placement rules. `parse_marker` may return empty components; only a harvested blank reason is deterministically rejected.

Consumers are `scripts/check_mechanism_delta.py`, `Makefile` lint, `tests/unit/test_mechanism_delta.py` (including direct `HEAD_LINES` import), architecture documentation, and the bare-repository portability test. Preserve both `# pragma: no cover - defensive` directives and all executable marker syntax byte-for-byte.
## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] The leaf commit changes only comments/docstrings or blank lines in the declared files; executable structure and exact directives remain unchanged.
- [ ] Every Scope constraint and consumer contract has a PASS row with concrete before/after citations in a leaf-linked TSV semantic matrix authored by a reviewer who did not write the remediation.
- [ ] Every edited block has an independent `bloat-removal` PASS row showing that redundant, obvious, duplicated, stale, or historical prose was removed while current rationale remained.
- [ ] Recorded focused checks, path-scoped `git diff --check`, and `make verify` pass at the leaf commit.
- [ ] Missing or FAIL semantic rows block closure.

## Verification
Run the recorded prose-only guards, focused tests, path-scoped diff check, and worktree-venv `make verify`. The independent matrix, not exact prose matching, judges semantic preservation.
